title: this is pure f*cking treasure
author: @beamnxw
desc:
this is pure f*cking treasure

20 GitHub repos to build your own motion design studio with Opus 5.5

storyboards. typography. assets. character states. keyframes. 3D. rendering

here’s the stack from the first sketch to the final frame

DESIGN + STORYBOARD
01 Penpot
https://github.com/penpot/penpot → layouts and reusable components  
02 Excalidraw
https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw → sketch the storyboard  
03 Fontsource
https://github.com/fontsource/fontsource → self-host your fonts  
04 Lucide
https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide → consistent SVG icons

ASSETS + CHARACTER ANIMATION
05 SVGO
https://github.com/svg/svgo → clean the vector assets  
06 sharp
https://github.com/lovell/sharp → resize, crop, and prepare images  
07 Lottie-web
https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web → play vector animations  
08 Rive Web
https://github.com/rive-app/rive-wasm → control character states

TIMELINES + CHOREOGRAPHY
09 Motion
https://github.com/motiondivision/motion → springs and layout transitions  
10 GSAP
https://github.com/greensock/GSAP → direct complex timelines  
11 Anime.js
https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime → choreograph SVG and objects  
12 Theatre.js
https://github.com/theatre-js/theatre → tune motion visually

3D + VISUAL POLISH
13 Three.js
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js → build the 3D scene  
14 React Three Fiber
https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber → compose 3D in React  
15 Drei
https://github.com/pmndrs/drei → cameras, lighting, and staging  
16 Postprocessing
https://github.com/pmndrs/postprocessing → bloom and color grading

PRODUCTION + EXPORT
17 Remotion
https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion → compose and render the video  
18 Remotion Skills
https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills → give Claude Code the production playbook  
19 FFmpeg
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg → encode and package the output  
20 Mediabunny
https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny → build browser media pipelines

start with Remotion + its skills

choose the assets, motion engine, and 3D modules your project needs

the clever part:

the composition lives in code
change the copy, colors, timing, or format → render the next version

the loop:

brief → storyboard → assets → layout → animate → add depth → preview → refine → render

save this, then read the full guide for Opus 5.5 Motion Engineering ↓

title: my Claude videos used to look generic
author: @francescoinweb3
desc:
my Claude videos used to look generic

clean, smooth and completely forgettable

the problem wasn’t the model. I was typing “make me a video about X” and hoping for the best

 now every video goes through the same 6 steps:

 > reference
I show Claude a video I actually like. it breaks down why it works: the pacing, where the first motion lands, how the text comes in, the cut rhythm
this one step fixes most of the generic look

>  data
real numbers before anything moves. every figure has a source
a wrong number in a beautiful animation is still wrong, it just looks more convincing

> story
one point, one hero number, three beats
written before any motion, so the video is about something

> motion
Claude writes the animation as code with Remotion and a motion-design skill
no video model, so every word, number and timing stays editable

 > direct
I don’t re-prompt. I just say what’s off:
“title is a beat late”  one line changes
“draw the line slower”  one line changes
nothing else breaks

 ship
it renders stills, checks them against the reference and the data
nothing goes out until I approve it

> most people jump straight to step 4 and wonder why it looks like everyone else’s

the real difference is step 1 and step 5: copy what works, then direct instead of re-rolling

full setup, the prompt and the 10 open-source skills are in the article
